{{nihongo|'''Ōbe Shrine'''|小戸神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

'''Ōbe Shrine''' (おおべじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in Ōbe, {{ill|Kawanishi, Hyōgo|Q609350|qid=Q609350}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} of {{ill|Kawabe District, Hyōgo|Q1042053|qid=Q1042053|lt=Kōbe District}}, {{ill|Settsu Province|Q864163|qid=Q864163}}. In the '{{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|Q11571092|qid=Q11571092}}' it is read "Obe," but today it is called "Ōbe."

=== History ===
In the '{{ill|Settsu Meisho Zue|Q11498549|qid=Q11498549}}' it says: "Located in Ōbe village. Appears in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki (Register of Deities)}}.' It is the ubusuna deity of Ōbe, Sakaine, Kobana and others." It was revered as the {{ill|Ubusunagami|Q1392097|qid=Q1392097}} over the west bank area of the {{ill|Ina River|Q11571867|qid=Q11571867}}.
* In August of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it became a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.
* In Meiji 42 ({{ill|1909|Q2057|qid=Q2057}}), Yasaka Shrine and Hosokawa-hime Shrine were merged.
* In {{ill|Shōwa era|ar|فترة شووا|br|Oadvezh Shōwa|ca|Període Shōwa|cs|Období Šówa|de|Shōwa-Zeit|eo|Ŝova-epoko|es|Era Shōwa|eu|Shōwa aroa|fa|دوره شووا|fi|Shōwa-kausi|fr|Ère Shōwa (1926-1989)|he|תקופת שווה|hi|शोवा युग|hu|Sóva-kor|id|Zaman Shōwa|it|Periodo Shōwa|ja|昭和|ka|შოვას პერიოდი|ko|쇼와 시대|lt|Šiova laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Shōwa|nl|Showaperiode|no|Shōwa-perioden|pl|Shōwa|pt|Período Shōwa|ru|Сёва|simple|Shōwa era|sr|Шова период|sv|Shōwa|th|ยุคโชวะ|tl|Panahong Shōwa|tr|Şova Dönemi|uk|Період Сьова|vi|Thời kỳ Chiêu Hòa|zh|昭和|zh_classical|昭和|zh_min_nan|Chiau-hô|zh_yue|昭和|qid=Q327567}} 42 ({{ill|1967|Q2648|qid=Q2648}}), a new {{ill|Honden|Q2044994|qid=Q2044994}} was built.
* In {{ill|Heisei era|Q234510|qid=Q234510}} 20 ({{ill|2008|Q2004|qid=Q2004}}), it was repaired<ref>Sadatoshi Yoshii, "Ōbe Shrine" ("Shikinaisha Survey Report", Vol. 5, Kōgakkan University Press, 1977) {{全国書誌番号|78005760}}</ref>.

=== Cultural properties ===
[[File:Ohbejinja02.jpg|150px|thumb|Great camphor tree (Hyogo Prefecture designated natural monument)]]
* Great camphor tree, designated {{ill|Natural monument|Q23790|qid=Q23790}} by {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}} (designated March 22, Shōwa 41) - root circumference approx. 12 {{ill|Metre|Q11573|qid=Q11573}}, height approx. 30 m, estimated age 500 years.

=== Transportation ===
* About 8 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kawanishi-Noseguchi Station|Q3969857|qid=Q3969857}} on the {{ill|Hankyu Takarazuka Main Line|Q3832859|qid=Q3832859}}
